title: Never grip the steering wheel like this (Part 1)
hook: Stop holding your steering wheel wrong.

script.narration: Stop holding your steering wheel wrong. Most beginners grip it at the 10 and 2 positions, but that’s actually outdated and dangerous for modern cars with airbags.
script.visual_search: close up of hands on steering wheel

script.narration: If an airbag deploys while your hands are at the top of the wheel, you risk serious injury. The safest spot is 9 and 3.
script.visual_search: steering wheel inside car from driver perspective

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for Part 2! Do you hold your wheel at 9 and 3? Tell me below. Because you should...

description: Stop holding your steering wheel in the 10 and 2 position. Learn why 9 and 3 is the safer standard for modern vehicles equipped with airbags. Essential driving tips for beginners to improve safety on the road. Follow for the second part of our steering safety series.
why_it_will_work: Leverages the high search volume for 'driving tips for new drivers' while correcting a common, dangerous habit with a clear visual hook.

series.name: Steering Safety
series.next_part_idea: How to properly turn the steering wheel without crossing your arms.
